record.question: Who among the following has been expelled from the Samajwadi Party?
record.explanation: Answer B: Amar Singh. The parliamentary Journal of June 2010, page 174, records that the Samajwadi Party expelled Amar Singh on 2 February 2010, before the 24 March exam. Historical/source note: Use the contemporaneous parliamentary account; another later parliamentary procedural summary dates a seating-record change to 23 February, which does not change who was expelled. Reference: https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/760900/1/jpi_june_2010.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
